item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. Taking it well is a system, not a matter of willpower. Tie each dose to something you already do every day, like a meal or brushing your teeth, so you stop relying on memory. If you have a pill organizer, check it is filled for the week. Notice any missed doses without judging yourself. Action: set one daily reminder on your phone right now.
